name: – § 4, after point 2, point 3 and after point 3 – Am 9-14
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a standing committee on Security and Defence and a standing committee on Public Health
section: Paragraph 4 – point 2 a (new) | Paragraph 4 – point 2 b (new) | Paragraph 4 – point 3 | Paragraph 4 – point 3 a (new) | Paragraph 4 – point 3 b (new) | Paragraph 4 – point 3 c (new)
part_text: (2a) In Part VI, the following point is inserted: ‘3a. the economic dimension of sustainable development;’ / (2b) In Part VII, the following point is inserted: ‘8a. the social dimension of sustainable development;’ / (3) Part VIII is replaced by the following: ‘VIII. Committee on the Environment Committee responsible for: 1. Environmental policy and protection measures, in particular concerning: c) air, soil and water pollution, waste management and recycling and noise levels, ca) Union measures concerning the ratification and implementation of international agreements, signed within the framework of the Convention on Biological Diversity, aimed at protecting biodiversity, d) chemicals, dangerous substances and preparations, pesticides and maximum residue levels, cosmetics, e) the environmental dimension of sustainable development, f) international and regional measures and agreements aimed at protecting the environment, g) restoration of environmental damage, h) civil protection, i) the European Environment Agency and the European Chemicals Agency; In the context of point 1(ca), the Committee on Agriculture, Rural Development and Food shall be joint pursuant to Rule 59 whenever the matter concerns agricultural land areas.’ / (3a) Part IX is amended as follows: (a) The following point is inserted: ‘5a. Union measures concerning the ratification and implementation of international agreements, signed within the framework of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, aimed at combating climate change;’ (b) the following subparagraph is added: ‘In the context of point 5a, the Committee on Transport and Tourism shall be joint pursuant to Rule 59 whenever the matter concerns land transport.’ / (3b) In Part XI, the following point is inserted: ‘1a. Union measures concerning the ratification and implementation of international agreements, signed within the framework of the International Maritime Organization and the International Civil Aviation Organization, aimed at combating climate change;’ / (3c) Part XIII is amended as follows: (a) the title is replaced by the following: ‘XIII. Committee on Agriculture, Rural Development and Food’ (b) point 3 is replaced by the following: ‘3. legislation on: a) plant-health matters, b) veterinary and animal feeding stuffs, c) animal husbandry and welfare;’ (c) the following point is inserted: ‘3a. food-related issues, including in particular: a) the labelling and safety of foodstuffs, b) public health checks on foodstuffs and food production systems, c) the European Food Safety Authority and the Health and Food Audits and Analysis;’
